# Activity By State (Rex's Group by priority): every pane whose program says
# how it's doing, under Waiting for you, Failed, Working and Done, the most
# pressing first, with what it last said (else its folder); idle panes
# aren't listed. (Reports: OSC 7501, msg in base64; a report goes when its
# program does, so each stays running.)
expect-activity:
type:cd /tmp; printf '\033]7501;state=working:app=claude-code:msg=UmVhZGluZyBmaWxlcw==\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
action:new_split:right
wait:0.8
type:cd /tmp; printf '\033]7501;state=blocked:app=codex\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
action:new_split:down
wait:0.8
type:printf '\033]7501;state=error:app=probe:msg=bWFrZSBmYWlsZWQ=\a'; sleep 60
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect-activity:Waiting for you (1)|  Codex — /tmp|Failed (1)|  sleep — make failed|Working (1)|  Claude Code — Reading files
